places.name: Adam Park
places.desc: Adam park estate was the site of intense fighting between British forces and the invading Japanese army in February 1942, in the last days before the British surrendered Singapore.

places.name: Alexandra Hospital
places.desc: Opened in 1940, the Alexandra Hospital (former British Military Hospital) served as the principal hospital for Britain's Far East Command during World War II.

places.name: Anglo-Chinese School
places.desc: The Anglo-Chinese School (ACS) was founded by Rev. William Fitzjames Oldham in 1886 at a shophouse in Amoy Street.

places.name: Balestier Plain
places.desc: Balestier Road, from which Balestier Plain takes its name, was named after Joseph Balestier, a keen botanist and agriculturist who arrived in Singapore in 1834.

places.name: Batu Berlayar
places.desc: Batu Berlayar ("Sailing Rock"), together with a rock on the opposite shore of Tanjong Rimau, formed a gateway to the west of Keppel Harbour.

places.name: Beach Road Police Station
places.desc: In the early 1900s, Singapore grew rapidly and the crime rate rose with the city's expansion.

places.name: Bukit Batok Memorials
places.desc: Two memorials, one for the Japanese soldiers and the other for Allied Soldiers sat on top on this hill-top.

places.name: Battle of Bukit Timah
places.desc: One of the fiercest military encounters during WWII took place here as the Bukit Timah area held strategic and tactical importance to the Japanese and the British.

places.name: Central Sikh Temple
places.desc: Also known as the Wadda Gurdwara, this Sikh temple was the first set up in a bungalow at Queen Street in 1912. The temple is now relocated at Towner Road.

places.name: Chen Wen Hsi Historic Marker
places.desc: This was formerly the home of Chen Wen Hsi, one of Singapore's pioneer artists.

places.name: Chui Eng Free School
places.desc: Chui Eng Free School was established here in 1854 by the Singapore Hokkien Huay Kuan.

places.name: Clifford Pier
places.desc: Clifford Pier was the landing point for sea passengers and immigrants who came to seek a new life in Singapore.

places.name: Custom House, Maxwell Road
places.desc: This was the headquarters of Singapore Customs from 1932 to 1989. The building also housed the Film Censor's Office and the Maxwell Road Post Office.

places.name: Ee Hoe Hean Club
places.desc: Founded in 1895, it is one of the oldest millionaires club in Singapore. The club was the centre of the Chinese Salvation Movement in Southeast Asia from 1937-1942.

places.name: Execution of Captured Rimau Commandos Historic Marker
places.desc: Operation Rimau ("tiger" in Malay) was the second Allied commando attack on Japanese ships in Keppel Harbour.

places.name: Farrer Park
places.desc: Farrer Park was the site of the first race course in Singapore, and continued to be a venue for numerous sporting events.

places.name: Force 136 Historic Marker
places.desc: Force 136 was a British secret service team that operated in Malaya during the Second World War. One of the agents was Lim Bo Seng, who led Gustavus V Operation in 1943.

places.name: Fuk Tak Chi
places.desc: This building housed Fuk Tak Chi ("Fu De Ci" in Mandarin), one of the Singapore's oldest Chinese temples, from the 1820s to 1994. It was later converted into a museum.

places.name: Gan Eng Seng School

places.name: Havelock Road Camp / River Valley Road Camp
places.desc: The area bounded by River Valley Road and Havelock Road was occupied by Prisoner-of-War (POW) camps during the Japanese Occupation.

places.name: Ho Chi Minh Historic Marker

places.name: Institute of Mental Health

places.name: Jalan Besar Stadium

places.desc: Dancing dragons and prancing phoenixes are just some of the visual delights to catch at the exquisitely restored Hong San See temple.

places.name: Indian National Army (INA) Monument
places.desc: The Indian National Army (INA) Monument at Esplanade Park is a memorial that was built in 1995 to mark the 50th anniversary of the end of World War II.

places.name: Joo Chiat/Katong: Singapore Peranakan Neighbourhood
places.desc: Discover Peranakan culture as you stroll past heritage shophouses, quaint stores and eateries in Joo Chiat/Katong, a charming corner of eastern Singapore.

places.name: Jurong Bird Park, Singapore: Attractions & Things to Do
places.desc: Jurong Bird Park has almost every species to impress avian lovers, along with fun exhibits, interactive shows, and of course, its charming residents.

places.name: Kranji War Memorial Landmark
places.desc: The Kranji War Memorial in Singapore honours the men and women from the Commonwealth who died in the line of duty during World War II.

places.name: Kusu Island
places.desc: Kusu Island lies to the south of Singapore, and has a wonderful mix of local heritage and beach activities.

places.name: Lasalle College of the Arts
places.desc: Lasalle College of the Arts evokes awe with its bold, graphic lines and stunning reinterpretation of nature.

places.name: Little India Singapore: History & Culture
places.desc: Little India is a buzzing historic district that shows off the best of Singapore’s Indian community, from vibrant culture to ethnic-inspired shopping.

places.name: MacRitchie Singapore & Singapore Nature Reserve
places.desc: The attractions around MacRitchie Reservoir caters to fitness fanatics, water sports enthusiasts and nature lovers.

places.name: Marina Bay Singapore: Attractions & Things to do
places.desc: Marina Bay represents all things modern and super-stylish in Singapore, from trendy dining destinations to fun leisure spots.

places.name: NUS University Museum
places.desc: Get a deeper insight into Asian art and artefacts at NUS Museum at Singapore’s leading university.

places.name: Old Ford Factory Singapore Museum
places.desc: The Old Ford Factory is a repository of memories about the hardships endured during the Japanese Occupation of Singapore.

places.name: Orchard Road, Singapore: Asia's Most Famous Shopping Street
places.desc: Don’t miss a trip to Orchard Road. Asia’s most famous shopping street is home to fashion favourites, specialist stores and loads of other lifestyle choices.

places.name: PARKROYAL on Pickering
places.desc: PARKROYAL on Pickering is a luxurious garden oasis in downtown Singapore.

places.name: Pulau Ubin & Singapore Islands
places.desc: Hop on a bumboat to the island of Pulau Ubin if you want a taste of nature and rustic village life, away from the hustle and bustle of Singapore.

places.name: Raffles
places.desc: Sip a Singapore Sling beneath the whirling fans at the Long Bar, and let the tranquil charms of Raffles Singapore bring you back into another era.

places.name: Reflections at Bukit Chandu: Singapore War Memorial
places.desc: Reflections at Bukit Chandu relives the Battle of Pasir Panjang, one of the fiercest battles fought against the Japanese in Singapore during World War II.

places.name: Resorts World Sentosa
places.desc: Whether it’s themes parks, world-class performances or celebrity restaurants, you’ll never run out of things to do at Resorts World™ Sentosa.

places.name: River Safari
places.desc: The River Safari Singapore is a fascinating new wildlife park that recreates life in and around the world’s rivers.

places.name: SAM at 8Q & Singapore Art Museum
places.desc: SAM at 8Q at the Singapore Art Museum showcases the works of Singapore contemporary artists.

places.name: Sentosa Island, Singapore: Leisure & Attractions
places.desc: Sentosa Island is Singapore’s favourite leisure destination, with more than 500 hectares filled with exciting attractions, golden beaches, luxe retreats and the country’s first...

places.name: Shophouses
places.desc: Few buildings epitomise our culture as fully as the shophouse, with its surprisingly harmonious mix of diverse design elements.

places.name: Singapore Coins and Notes Museum & Museum
places.desc: The Singapore Coins and Notes Museum tells the story of Singapore through the currencies it has used over the years.

places.name: Singapore Garden & Singapore Park
places.desc: The Southern Ridges is a 10-km stretch of connecting trails which lets you walk among the trees to observe a wide variety of flora and fauna in their natural habitat.

places.name: Singapore River: History & Culture Tours
places.desc: Get to know the historic Singapore River and its famous quays: Boat Quay, Clarke Quay and Robertson Quay. This, after all, is where it all began.

places.name: Singapore Zoo: Attractions & Things to Do
places.desc: Catch animals in their natural habitats at the award-winning Singapore Zoo.

places.name: SIT Flats
places.desc: The Art Deco elegance of the flats in Tiong Bahru speak of the richness of a vanished world.

places.name: Sri Mariamman Temple: Hindu Temple
places.desc: Sri Mariamman Temple, located in Chinatown, is the oldest Hindu temple in Singapore.

places.name: Sungei Buloh
places.desc: The ecological wonder of Sungei Buloh will transport you into a world rich in animal and plant life.

places.name: Universal Studios Singapore™ Theme Park
places.desc: Universal Studios Singapore™ at Resorts World™ Sentosa is a movie-themed entertainment park that the whole family can enjoy.

places.name: Victoria Theatre
places.desc: The historic Victoria Theatre and Concert Hall has been transformed to meet the needs of a modern audience.
